units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:15">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ומצא שם צ׳ גדול</he> and found there a large rock; a. e.—Pl. <he>צוּרִים</he>.

Ib. כאן … על הצ׳ הללו here I will build the fortress, on these rocks.—[Tosef. Pes. VII, 13 שומרי צו׳ ed. Zuck., read: צִירִים, v. צִיר II).—Trnsf. [Protection,] the Lord; (in Agadah derived from יָצַר; v. next w.) the Creator.
Ber. 5ᵇ (ref. to Job XVIII, 4) אין צ׳ אלא הקב״ה tsur means the Holy One &c. (with ref. to Deut. XXXII, 18).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:3">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> (ref. to Deut. l. c.) <he>התשתם … יוצר</he> you have weakened the power of the Creator.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 43:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIII</cite> <he>מרד בצ׳ עליון</he> rebelled against the Rock on high; a. fr.
